# World Brief — Wednesday, 14 October 2026

**In one line:** US inflation jumped to 3.7% on soaring energy costs while Middle East conflict escalation drove oil prices higher, even as India and the US inched closer to a trade agreement.

## 🚨 Top 5 things to know
